ModMetaData.name: Division of Labor
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Splits RimWorld's broadest work types into focused jobs, so you can assign specialists instead of generalists.
New work types: Nurse - feeding, rescuing and tending to the comfort of patients, split out of Doctor and Warden. Doctors keep the surgery and medicine. Butcher - butcher table bills, split out of Cooking. Deconstruct - deconstructing, uninstalling, and removing floors and roofs, split out of Construction. Repair - repairing and fixing broken-down buildings, split out of Construction.
Reordered so related jobs sit together in the Work tab: Fishing moved next to Hunting. Plant cutting moved next to Growing. Dark study folded into Research as its first job.
Supported mods are folded in rather than left as separate columns: Hospitality and Therapy join Warden, Simple Improve joins Construction, and Recycle This joins Crafting.
New colonies start with manual work priorities switched on; you can turn them off in the Work tab as usual. Loading an existing colony never changes the setting.
Safe to add to an existing save. Removing it mid-save will reset the affected work priorities.
